text:
sam: Heads-up — planning a quiet-window rollout for a routing-policy change (NA -> EU edge) on Wed 2026-05-20 02:00 UTC. Need a deploy owner, smoke lead, and rollback owner. Pinged #eng-sre for oncall.

lee: I can take deploy owner if we keep the window 02:00-03:00 UTC.

maria: I'll run the smoke checks and post results. Link to runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/edge-routing-rollout (will follow the checklist there).

sam: Quick smoke checklist (condensed):
```
1) Verify route-weight config applied
2) Curl health endpoints via EU edge (200s, no errors)
3) Check 95p latency and P50 dashboards
4) Confirm no routing 5xx or increased error-rate
```

kai: For rollback we need two things ready: route-weight revert script and DNS TTL reduction script. I pushed helpers to infra/tools: `git@repo:redwood/infra#route-tools`. Recommend reducing DNS TTL to 60s ~10m before shift. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — maintenance banner will go up at 01:50 UTC on merge day. :calendar: 

jamie: +1 on TTL reduction. If we lower to 60s before shift rollback will be much faster.

maria: I'll set TTL and confirm once done (posting timestamp here).

sam: Abort criteria (quick): error-rate > 1% or sustained P50 > 500ms for 5 minutes — abort and rollback.

anita: I'll cover rollback coordination. If needed I'll run `./scripts/route-revert --target eu` and validate traffic fallbacks. I'll also coordinate DNS revert.

lee: Are we doing a canary stage? I'd prefer 10% first for 15m, then 50% for 15m, then 100%.

sam: Agreed. Plan: 10% -> 50% (15m) -> 100% (15m). I'll create the canary route policy and post the policy link here before the window.

maria: I'll run the smoke runner during each stage and paste the basic output (curl success counts + latency p50/p95).

kai: Quick staging dry-run succeeded earlier today. Commands used in staging:
```
./tools/apply-route --policy na->eu --weight 10
./tools/check-smoke --target eu
```
No errors, KV cache keys look healthy.

sam: Locking window and owners: deploy=lee, smoke=maria, rollback=anita, infra=kai. @eng-sre oncall please standby for the window.

ops-bot: Maintenance banner scheduled for Wed 2026-05-20 01:50 UTC.

lee: :thumbsup: I'll post a start timestamp when I begin and a done timestamp when complete. See you in the window.
